info.name: E7GZ PS — E7-25 opening hours
info.description: E7-25: GET / preview / commit of the venue's opening hours (FR-VEN-17…FR-VEN-27). Needs seed-test-accounts.sql (admin postman.admin@e7gz.test) and the backend with the api profile. Each run creates its own area, two venues and two venue accounts, so it can be re-run. Session rows, DST and affected bookings are checked by the backend tests (OpeningHoursHttpTest, SessionGeneratorTest, SessionPlanTest): there is no booking API yet to create an affected booking from here.

item.name: 2.1 · GET before any save → version 0, every day CLOSED

exec: pm.test("seven days, 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday, all CLOSED", () => { pm.expect(h.days.map(d => d.weekday)).to.eql([0,1,2,3,4,5,6]); h.days.forEach(d => pm.expect(d.mode).to.eql("CLOSED")); });
pm.test("an empty full-day default (valid to send back)", () => { pm.expect(h.defaultFullDay).to.eql(true); pm.expect(h.defaultOpen).to.eql(h.defaultClose); });
